name: codepen
title: CodePen
description: Search, create, and manage your CodePen Pens, collections, and assets with API v2.
author: 0xdhrv

commands.name: search-pens
commands.title: Search Pens
commands.subtitle: CodePen
commands.description: Search your Pens, browse source files and versions, edit, fork, and manage deployments

commands.name: create-pen
commands.title: Create Pen
commands.subtitle: CodePen
commands.description: Create a CodePen 2.0 Pen with starter files or your own HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

commands.name: search-collections
commands.title: Search Collections
commands.subtitle: CodePen
commands.description: Browse your collections and manage their Pens

commands.name: create-collection
commands.title: Create Collection
commands.subtitle: CodePen
commands.description: Create a collection to organize your Pens

commands.name: search-assets
commands.title: Search Assets
commands.subtitle: CodePen
commands.description: Browse, copy, rename, and delete your hosted assets

commands.name: upload-asset
commands.title: Upload Asset
commands.subtitle: CodePen
commands.description: Upload a file to CodePen Asset Hosting and copy its URL

tools.name: search-my-pens
tools.title: Search My Pens
tools.description: Search ONLY Pens owned by your API key. Cannot find public community Pens, trending Pens, or other users’ work; do not use this tool for those requests. Returns one page with a next-page URL.

tools.name: get-pen
tools.title: Get Pen
tools.description: Read a Pen and its saved source files, version ID, deployment, and build diagnostics. Classic Pens are read-only.

tools.name: get-build
tools.title: Get Build
tools.description: Check a build’s status and next_id. Follow next_id when CodePen applies compiler changes.

tools.name: create-pen
tools.title: Create Pen
tools.description: Create a CodePen 2.0 Pen and build its source files. Returns the saved Pen and build status.

tools.name: update-pen
tools.title: Update Pen
tools.description: Edit a CodePen 2.0 Pen’s title, description, tags, template flag, or privacy.

tools.name: write-files
tools.title: Write Source Files
tools.description: Write text files to a 2.0 Pen using the version ID you read. Saves and builds once; never automatically retries writes.

tools.name: fork-pen
tools.title: Fork Pen
tools.description: Fork one of your CodePen 2.0 Pens. First read it with Get Pen to preserve its privacy. If its access is Protected, ask the user for a new password before calling this tool. Never generate a password or make the fork public without the user requesting it.

tools.name: set-deployment
tools.title: Set Deployment
tools.description: Deploy the latest successful saved version of a Pen, or take its deployment down.

tools.name: delete-pen
tools.title: Trash Pen
tools.description: Move a CodePen 2.0 Pen to the trash. It can be restored on CodePen for 3 days.

tools.name: list-collections
tools.title: List Collections
tools.description: List one page of your collections, or your Pens in a collection. Follow next-page URLs to see more.

tools.name: save-collection
tools.title: Save Collection
tools.description: Create a collection or update an existing collection’s details.

tools.name: set-collection-pen
tools.title: Set Collection Membership
tools.description: Add a Pen to one of your collections or remove it without deleting the Pen.

tools.name: delete-collection
tools.title: Trash Collection
tools.description: Trash a collection without deleting its Pens. Restorable on CodePen for 3 days.

tools.name: list-assets
tools.title: List Assets
tools.description: List one page of hosted assets. Follow the next-page URL to see more.

tools.name: get-asset
tools.title: Get Asset
tools.description: Read hosted asset details and text content when available.

tools.name: create-text-asset
tools.title: Create Text Asset
tools.description: Upload a text asset with a unique filename. Requires CodePen PRO.

tools.name: delete-asset
tools.title: Delete Asset
tools.description: Permanently delete a hosted asset. Existing links stop working.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Generate an API key in CodePen Settings → API (https://codepen.io/settings/api). Personal keys access your work; team keys access that team’s work.
